name: Futu Exercises Incremental Merge
description: Futu 行权记录 base + 增量按 员工号+授予编号+行权日期 幂等合并：base 是上月完整 to-date（14 列，新行不带行权订单编号），增量既可读富途「员工行权记录」导出的『行权汇总数据』sheet（中文 13 列），也可读月度 Cap Table 工作簿的『Futu BCI Exercises to Date』sheet（英文 13 列，同一张表、同一批数字），按业务月截断后按业务粒度覆盖合并，产出当月完整 base 供下游求和，并落盘固定路径供下月链式。

tasks.name: Extract Base Futu Exercises
tasks.description: 读取上月 Futu BCI Exercises base（14 列，第 1 行表头，新行不带行权订单编号），也可以直接指向 Cap Table 工作簿的『Futu BCI Exercises to Date』（13 列，缺的那一列由下一个任务补空）。

tasks.name: Extract Futu Exercise Increment (Summary or To-Date sheet)

params.emptyColumns: 姓名, 工号, 牛牛号, 用户ID, 授予编号, 授予日期, 授予价(USD), 行权日期, 行权下单数量, 行权成功数量, 行权成本(USD), 扣除/卖出数量, 成交数量

tasks.description: 读取行权增量：富途「员工行权记录」导出的『行权汇总数据』（中文 13 列）或月度 Cap Table 工作簿的『Futu BCI Exercises to Date』（英文 13 列）。两张表是同构的（一人一天一行，末行为合计/in Total），sheet 由页面上手动选择。不用『行权明细数据』：明细是界面导出，列契约与分页窗口随导出状态变化。该输入为可选：未提供时输出带列契约的空 dataframe，由 base 独立成表。

tasks.name: Project Futu Summary Increment to Base Contract

params.failureMessage: Futu increment 列数应为 13：请选『行权汇总数据』或『Futu BCI Exercises to Date』；行权明细数据是 59 列

guards.name: Assert Futu Increment Has Employee No

params.sql:
select count(*) as actual from {increment}
where coalesce(trim(cast(coalesce([工号], '') as string)), '') = ''
  and coalesce(trim(cast(coalesce([Employee No.], '') as string)), '') = ''
  and coalesce(trim(cast(coalesce([姓名], [Name], '') as string)), '') not in ('合计', 'in Total')
params.failureMessage: Futu increment 有行没有员工号（工号/Employee No.）；合并键不成立

params.sql:
select
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([姓名], [Name], '') as string)), '') as [Name],
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([工号], [Employee No.], '') as string)), '') as [Employee No.],
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([牛牛号], [Futubull ID], '') as string)), '') as [Futubull ID],
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([用户ID], [User ID], '') as string)), '') as [User ID],
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([授予编号], [Grant No.], '') as string)), '') as [Grant No.],
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([授予日期], [Grant Date], '') as string)), '') as [Grant Date],
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([授予价(USD)], [Grant Price(USD)], '') as string)), '') as [Grant Price(USD)],
  nullif(trim(cast(coalesce([行权日期], [Exercise Date], '') as string)), '') as [Exercise Date],
  case when cast(coalesce([行权下单数量], [Ordered Qty], 0) as string) in ('--','','null') then 0 else cast(coalesce([行权下单数量], [Ordered Qty]) as number) end as [Ordered Qty],
  case when cast(coalesce([行权成功数量], [Exercised Qty], 0) as string) in ('--','','null') then 0 else cast(coalesce([行权成功数量], [Exercised Qty]) as number) end as [Exercised Qty],
  case when cast(coalesce([行权成本(USD)], [Exercise Cost(USD)], 0) as string) in ('--','','null') then 0 else cast(coalesce([行权成本(USD)], [Exercise Cost(USD)]) as number) end as [Exercise Cost(USD)],
  case when cast(coalesce([扣除/卖出数量], [Deduction/Selling Qty.], 0) as string) in ('--','','null') then 0 else cast(coalesce([扣除/卖出数量], [Deduction/Selling Qty.]) as number) end as [Deduction/Selling Qty.],
  case when cast(coalesce([成交数量], [Dealt Qty.], 0) as string) in ('--','','null') then 0 else cast(coalesce([成交数量], [Dealt Qty.]) as number) end as [Dealt Qty.]
from {increment}
where coalesce(trim(cast(coalesce([工号], [Employee No.], '') as string)), '') <> ''
  and coalesce(trim(cast(coalesce([姓名], [Name], '') as string)), '') not in ('合计', 'in Total')
  and wf_month_key(coalesce([行权日期], [Exercise Date])) is not null
  and wf_month_key(coalesce([行权日期], [Exercise Date])) <= {constants.workflowMonth}
order by coalesce([行权日期], [Exercise Date]), coalesce([工号], [Employee No.])

tasks.description: 把行权增量的 13 列投影成 base 的 14 列契约（含遗留的 Exercise Order No. 列，新行留空）：中文『行权汇总数据』与英文『Futu BCI Exercises to Date』列名不同、语义同构，用 coalesce(中文列, 英文列) 同时吃下两种表头；丢弃「合计」/「in Total」行与空工号行，"--" 空值归一为 0，并按 workflow 业务月截断行权日期。粒度是 员工号+授予编号+行权日期，一行即一个人一天的全部行权。

tasks.name: Ensure Base Carries The Legacy Order No Column
tasks.description: 给基表补上遗留的 Exercise Order No. 列：我们自己产出的 base 文件带这一列（历史行有值），而月度 Cap Table 工作簿的『Futu BCI Exercises to Date』只有 13 列。补空值不改变任何数量，但让同一段合并 SQL / 落盘契约同时接受两种基表。

tasks.name: Retain Base Rows the Summary Does Not Restate

params.failureMessage: Futu base schema changed: 缺少合并键或数量列
params.expectedColumns: Exercise Order No., Name, Employee No., Futubull ID, User ID, Grant No., Grant Date, Grant Price(USD), Exercise Date, Ordered Qty, Exercised Qty, Exercise Cost(USD), Deduction/Selling Qty., Dealt Qty.

params.sql:
select [Exercise Order No.], [Name], [Employee No.], [Futubull ID], [User ID], [Grant No.],
  [Grant Date], [Grant Price(USD)], [Exercise Date], [Ordered Qty], [Exercised Qty],
  [Exercise Cost(USD)], [Deduction/Selling Qty.], [Dealt Qty.]
from {base} b
where trim(cast(coalesce(b.[Employee No.], '') as string)) <> ''
  and not exists (
  select 1 from {projected_increment} i
   where upper(trim(cast(coalesce(i.[Employee No.], '') as string))) = upper(trim(cast(coalesce(b.[Employee No.], '') as string)))
     and upper(trim(cast(coalesce(i.[Grant No.], '') as string))) = upper(trim(cast(coalesce(b.[Grant No.], '') as string)))
     and coalesce(wf_date_key(i.[Exercise Date]), '') = coalesce(wf_date_key(b.[Exercise Date]), '')
)

tasks.description: 保留 base 中未被本次增量重述的行：没有员工号的 base 行（合计行/页脚，例如 Cap Table 工作簿的『in Total』）不是行权记录，直接丢弃；其次只要增量里有同一个 员工号+授予编号+行权日期 的汇总行，base 里该粒度的行（无论是否带行权订单编号）都丢弃，避免明细行与汇总行重复计数；增量没提到的历史月份原样保留，历史不丢。

tasks.name: Ensure Retained Base Keeps Its Column Contract
tasks.description: 给保留后的 base 补回 14 列契约：当增量把 base 的每一行都重述时（例如把 Cap Table 的 to-date sheet 直接当增量），retain 的 SQL 结果为空，而 sql.compute 在 0 行时不带出列，下游合并守卫就会报「缺少合并键列」。补齐列名不产生任何行，只保证空结果也是一个合法的 14 列 dataframe。

params.columns: Exercise Order No., Name, Employee No., Futubull ID, User ID, Grant No., Grant Date, Grant Price(USD), Exercise Date, Ordered Qty, Exercised Qty, Exercise Cost(USD), Deduction/Selling Qty., Dealt Qty.

tasks.name: Merge Base and Summary Increment Idempotently

params.failureMessage: Retained Futu base is missing a merge key column
params.expectedColumns: Exercise Order No., Grant No., Exercise Date, Exercised Qty

guards.name: Assert Futu Increment Has Employee No

params.sql: select count(*) as actual from {increment} where [Employee No.] is null or trim(cast([Employee No.] as string)) = ''
params.failureMessage: Futu increment has rows without 工号; 合并键不成立

params.sql: select count(*) as actual from {increment} i where (select count(*) from {increment} d where coalesce(d.[Employee No.], '') = coalesce(i.[Employee No.], '') and coalesce(d.[Grant No.], '') = coalesce(i.[Grant No.], '') and coalesce(wf_date_key(d.[Exercise Date]), '') = coalesce(wf_date_key(i.[Exercise Date]), '')) > 1
params.failureMessage: Futu increment repeats 员工号+授予编号+行权日期; 去重口径不明确

params.sql:
select
  case when i.[Employee No.] is not null and trim(cast(i.[Employee No.] as string)) <> '' then i.[Exercise Order No.] else b.[Exercise Order No.] end as [Exercise Order No.],
  case when i.[Name] is not null and trim(cast(i.[Name] as string)) <> '' then i.[Name] else b.[Name] end as [Name],
  case when i.[Employee No.] is not null and trim(cast(i.[Employee No.] as string)) <> '' then i.[Employee No.] else b.[Employee No.] end as [Employee No.],
  case when i.[Futubull ID] is not null and trim(cast(i.[Futubull ID] as string)) <> '' then i.[Futubull ID] else b.[Futubull ID] end as [Futubull ID],
  case when i.[User ID] is not null and trim(cast(i.[User ID] as string)) <> '' then i.[User ID] else b.[User ID] end as [User ID],
  case when i.[Grant No.] is not null and trim(cast(i.[Grant No.] as string)) <> '' then i.[Grant No.] else b.[Grant No.] end as [Grant No.],
  case when i.[Grant Date] is not null and trim(cast(i.[Grant Date] as string)) <> '' then i.[Grant Date] else b.[Grant Date] end as [Grant Date],
  case when i.[Grant Price(USD)] is not null and trim(cast(i.[Grant Price(USD)] as string)) <> '' then i.[Grant Price(USD)] else b.[Grant Price(USD)] end as [Grant Price(USD)],
  case when i.[Exercise Date] is not null and trim(cast(i.[Exercise Date] as string)) <> '' then i.[Exercise Date] else b.[Exercise Date] end as [Exercise Date],
  case when i.[Ordered Qty] is not null then i.[Ordered Qty] else b.[Ordered Qty] end as [Ordered Qty],
  case when i.[Exercised Qty] is not null then i.[Exercised Qty] else b.[Exercised Qty] end as [Exercised Qty],
  case when i.[Exercise Cost(USD)] is not null then i.[Exercise Cost(USD)] else b.[Exercise Cost(USD)] end as [Exercise Cost(USD)],
  case when i.[Deduction/Selling Qty.] is not null then i.[Deduction/Selling Qty.] else b.[Deduction/Selling Qty.] end as [Deduction/Selling Qty.],
  case when i.[Dealt Qty.] is not null then i.[Dealt Qty.] else b.[Dealt Qty.] end as [Dealt Qty.]
from {retained_base} b
full outer join {projected_increment} i
  on upper(trim(cast(coalesce(b.[Employee No.], '') as string))) = upper(trim(cast(coalesce(i.[Employee No.], '') as string)))
 and upper(trim(cast(coalesce(b.[Grant No.], '') as string))) = upper(trim(cast(coalesce(i.[Grant No.], '') as string)))
 and coalesce(wf_date_key(b.[Exercise Date]), '') = coalesce(wf_date_key(i.[Exercise Date]), '')
order by coalesce(b.[Exercise Date], i.[Exercise Date]),
         coalesce(b.[Employee No.], i.[Employee No.]),
         coalesce(b.[__workflow_row_number], 1000000 + i.[__workflow_row_number])

tasks.description: 按 员工号+授予编号+行权日期 full outer join 幂等合并保留后的 base 与投影后的增量：同粒度以增量（汇总）覆盖，增量没提到的历史行保留，按 Exercise Date / Employee No. 升序输出 14 列。
